action_instruction: Checking the matching order in the Open orders table
intent: whether the Open orders table contains an order row with 10 shares, a $60.00 limit price, Good for day expiry, and Pending status

action_params.condition: The "Open orders" table lists an order for 10 shares with limit price "$60.00", expiry "Good for day" and status "Pending".
action_params.query: whether the Open orders table contains an order row with 10 shares, a $60.00 limit price, Good for day expiry, and Pending status
action_params.code_js: Array.from(el(10).querySelectorAll('tr')).some(row => { const cells = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('td')).map(cell => cell.textContent.trim()); return cells.includes('10') && cells.includes('$60.00') && cells.includes('Good for day') && cells.includes('Pending'); })

assertion_tree.description: the "Open orders" table lists an order for 10 shares with limit price "$60.00", expiry "Good for day" and status "Pending"

sub_results.description: The "Open orders" table lists an order for 10 shares with limit price "$60.00", expiry "Good for day" and status "Pending".

assertion_tree.verification: The current "Open orders" table lists an order for 10 shares with limit price "$60.00", expiry "Good for day" and status "Pending".
